title: Make standard s-rust-pinned-toolchain pass
body: Outcome: `krn standards check --record s-rust-pinned-toolchain` no longer fails s-rust-pinned-toolchain.

Why: adoption found this reflex standard failing: exit 1 from [ -f Cargo.toml ] || exit 0; git ls-files | grep -qE '(^|/)rust-toolchain(\.toml)?$' && exit 0; git grep -qIE '^rust-version[[:space:]]*[.=]' -- Car...
Files: the files the failing check names (run the Proof command).
